verdict.rationale: Expensify's API docs describe generating general API credentials and using OAuth2 to obtain short-lived tokens on behalf of a user, but there's no evidence of scoped/least-privilege credential issuance specifically designed for agent use cases (e.g., granular permission scopes, agent-specific role restrictions). Missing for 10: scoped/permissioned API key or token creation, agent-specific credential controls, documentation of least-privilege design.
